In life, it's really important that everyone appreciates the BRTA Power Ratings Tests. This is important in our consideration of the TROLS Associations.
Has anyone ever stopped to think about how the associations feel? Or are you just selfish, and just take the information for granted?
I can name at least three other associations that wish they were on TROLS. The ancient-ness of TROLS is like an attraction that every modern day tennis club wants.
No one in their right mind would navigate out of TROLS.

That's why WE need to take action. Someone, get TROLS to collaborate with BRTA Power Ratings. I don't care who does it; me, someone from the dev team, heck, even 4.2 Melody.

Just get someone to expand this project into something other than just a boring static site! There isn't even any servers! Like come on!

Expand! Be better! Be good!

Sincerely, the BRTA Power Ratings Development Team
